independentReview.scope: Independent process/source review of current generated-only callers; not human acceptance or cryptographic reviewer authentication.

rationale: The mounted plaintext is required by the real nonroot _FILE loader contract; its password is generated internally for an owned isolated database, never supplied by a deployment/user credential argument.
Native host/daemon and writable tmpfs admission precede creation. The owned parent is0700; exclusive nofollow file creation is0600 before payload and0444 only for readonly nonroot container access.
Plaintext is outside retained artifact roots, diagnostics redact its generated value, and cleanup failure prevents qualification success.

Exactly one query-specific sink annotation is applied; the recovery test helper has no annotation. Dataflow, all CodeQL categories, existing blocking thresholds and paginated findings checks stay visible/unchanged.
expiry: Deployment tooling pins all four authority/caller sources and scans direct/import-aliased Python callers under executable source roots. Changes require refreshed independent review before qualification; this is not a general Python sandbox.
residuals: This is an explicit local scanner-coverage exception. Same-user/root access, possible tmpfs swap and abrupt host/process termination remain lifecycle limits.
Source-hash review records are auditable process evidence, not cryptographic approval. New callers or credential inputs require review.
Exact-revision CodeQL and current named-ref finding readback are still required; this record does not close an alert.
